visual.general_description: Grayscale sector-shaped echocardiogram showing four dark cardiac chambers labeled RV, LV, RA and LA, with a double-headed white arrow near the upper right edge of the sector.
visual.detailed_description: Black-background grayscale ultrasound image in a fan (sector) shape with its apex at the top. Four chamber regions are labeled in white lettering: RV at the upper left of the midline, LV at the upper right, RA at the lower left and LA at the lower center. Two thin bright curved bands run from the top toward the bottom between and beside the ventricles, and bright irregular echogenic areas lie along the lower right and lower left parts of the sector. A short white double-headed arrow sits near the upper right edge of the sector, next to a thin bright curved line at the right margin of the LV region. Small orientation and scale text at the lower left reads P, G, R with the numbers 3.0 and 8.0 beside a small diamond symbol; a grayscale bar is cut off at the top right corner. No patient name, date or other identifying text is visible, and no panel letters are printed.
